name: 科陆电子
thesis: 美的集团控股赋能，电网+储能双轮驱动。收入+23.4%，利润+245%爆发式增长。合同负债10亿(+24%)订单充足。电网设备行业自2025年5月持续走强。十五五国网4万亿投资+美国750亿美元电网扩建+储能印尼基地2026投产。北向6.3%。MA距离安全(ma5=0.5%, ma10=2.5%, ma20=7.1%)。

history.note: Best acting position, profit cushion building, and power/grid theme remains aligned with broader new-energy strength; no stop trigger.

Still above hard stop and day-3 drawdown is only about -1.1% from entry. Electric-grid thesis remains supported by policy and industry capex, though sector is not in today's top-5 and volume is slightly below MAVOL30, so no add.
电网设备不在今日top5但仍属近期强势主线之一，现价9.58距离硬止损9.26仍有3.3%缓冲；持仓第3天，较入场价9.75仅-1.74%，未触发首3日-3%卖出规则。需注意成交量低于MAVOL30且接近止损，不加仓。

Hard stop already violated. Current price 8.23 vs entry 9.75 is -15.59%, far beyond the non-negotiable -5% exit. Sector is not in the hot leadership group and position has also exceeded the 10-day time window without positive progress.
